An acceptance on 2011-09-17, the gazette date of the other 8·30 개각 successors, is possible. The gap to 고흥길 is a vacancy either way.

Vacancies in 특임장관, which the law made optional (제17조 '둘 수 있다'). (1) 2008-02-29..2009-09-20 (570 days). The two 특임장관 designates of 2008-02-18 (남주홍, 이춘호) were moved to 통일부 and 여성부 on 2008-02-20..22 and the parties agreed not to fill the post at first (국민일보 2008-02-20 BigKinds 01100201.20080220100000888, 영남일보 2008-02-21 BigKinds 01500801.2008022110000025362).
